title: Chapter 483 - 483 I Am The Largest Stockholder; Meeting Huo Qilong Again!
content:
Chapter 483 - 483 I Am The Largest Stockholder; Meeting Huo Qilong Again!

Chapter 483 - 483 I Am the Largest Stockholder; Meeting Huo Qilong Again!

483 I Am the Largest Stockholder; Meeting Huo Qilong Again!

How smart was Lin Fan?

The waiter’s attitude had changed so much. How could he not understand who had called just now?

Lin Fan waved his hand. “No, it’s alright. We can go now, right?”

“Of course,” the waiter hurriedly said. “Take care, distinguished guests.”

The outstanding employees of Flower Stem finally realized what was going on after they walked out of the restaurant.

“He… He’s letting us go?”

Lin Fan smiled. “Yeah.”

Then, he saw that the woman in pink glasses seemed to be a little worried.

“I forgot to tell you that I’m the biggest shareholder of the Whitehorse Manor. It’s just a cup, and the price is not worth much.” Therefore, everyone did not need to worry about it.

Except for Chu Yunyue, everyone’s mouth was wide open, and they were stunned on the spot.

The biggest shareholder of the Whitehorse Manor, which was known as the number one resort in the Maldives, was Lin Fan!

Lin Fan paused and said, “Oh right, Grians, the white man who picked us up from the airport yesterday, is the chairman of the Whitehorse Manor. If you need anything, you can call him directly.”

Now that he had made public his relationship with the Whitehorse Manor, he did not mind saying more.

In order to prevent anything from happening again, he would be able to deal with it in time.

When everyone heard this, they were stunned again.

One had to know…

Grians had been bowing and scraping when he picked them up, just like an ordinary waiter.

In the end, he turned out to be the chairman of the Whitehorse Manor?

…

Lin Fan ignored the shocked crowd. He held Chu Yunyue’s slender hand and continued walking forward.

Li Rujing, who was walking behind, could not help but whisper, “Who exactly is Mr. Lin?”

No wonder she would ask such a question.

Lin Fan’s performance was simply too shocking.

“Do you still remember the Xia Airlines plane we took?” Yang Changlin asked.

Li Rujing nodded.

“Mr. Lin is also the largest shareholder of Xia Airlines,” Yang Changlin said.

Li Rujing was stunned again.

Xia Airlines!

That was the largest state-owned airline!

Earlier, Li Rujing thought that the stewardesses were so respectful to Lin Fan because he booked the plane.

Now, it seemed that this was not the case at all.

The real reason was that Lin Fan was the biggest shareholder of Xia Airlines, the real boss!

Yang Changlin gently patted Li Rujing’s shoulder and said, “It’s your good fortune that Mr. Lin thinks highly of you. Work hard and your future will definitely be bright!”

Only then did Li Rujing come back to her senses. She nodded vigorously and said, “Yes!”

…

Lin Fan led the group on the soft sand, moving forward.

They saw…

A large bonfire had already been lit in the open space far away.

A group of people sat on the ground in front of the bonfire and chatted with each other.

Some were singing and dancing around the bonfire. It was very joyous.

Lin Fan, Chu Yunyue, Yang Changlin, Li Rujing, and the other outstanding employees of Flower Stem were also affected by the atmosphere. They felt even more relaxed and carefree.

Not long after they arrived at the bonfire party, a fashionable man in a colorful shirt and sunglasses walked over.

It was Huo Qilong whom they had met at the airport yesterday.

Huo Qilong scanned the scene with his squinty eyes.

He looked like a hungry wolf looking for prey.

Looking for prey?

That was right!

He was looking for prey.

However, most hungry wolves were looking for sheep.

He was looking for beautiful women!

The next moment, Huo Qilong raised his eyebrows.

He had discovered Chu Yunyue!

Ever since he saw Chu Yunyue at the airport yesterday…

Huo Qilong’s head seemed to be completely filled with her.

As a result, he tossed and turned the entire night and could not fall asleep.

He did not expect to meet her again today!

Indeed, the heavens were looking out for him!

However, his gaze soon fell on Lin Fan, who was beside Chu Yunyue.

Huo Qilong knew that if he walked over directly, it would be the same as yesterday. There would be no effect at all.

He had to do something to attract the other party’s attention. It would be best if he made her eyes light up!

Only in this way could he leave a trace of an impression in the other party’s heart!

It had to be said that Huo Qilong did have some ability to get a girlfriend.

As he pondered, he kept looking around…

Soon, his eyes focused on a piano not far away.

One had to know…

Huo Qilong had received a good education since he was young. He knew how to play the piano and guitar, how to paint, and how to play chess.

Among all the skills, he was the most talented in piano.

In fact, he was often praised by the teachers.

The corner of Huo Qilong’s mouth curled up slightly. He grinned and said, “I got it!”

As he spoke, he quickly walked toward the piano and slowly sat down.

Then, Huo Qilong took a deep breath.

His hands began to dance rapidly on the black and white keys.

In an instant…

A melodious piano tune slowly rippled out.

Soon, it attracted the attention of many people at the bonfire party.

Some of them even swayed to the rhythm of the piano music and started discussing.

“It’s Moonlight Modifications!”

“Not bad!”

“Yes, yes!”

…

When the piano song was about to end, one of the staff of Flower Stem looked over and said in surprise, “It’s that person!”

When Chu Yunyue heard it, she looked over curiously.

It was also at this moment that the piano piece came to an end.

There was a burst of sparse applause.

Huo Qilong raised his head with a smile.

When he saw that Chu Yunyue was also looking at him, the smile on his face widened.

His choice was indeed correct!

He had definitely left a good impression on her!

As Huo Qilong thought of this, he slowly walked toward Chu Yunyue under the gaze of everyone.

Then, like a gentleman, he smiled and said, “Beautiful lady, what a coincidence. We meet again.”

He was dressed in a ruffian manner, but he forced himself to act like a gentleman… It gave off a nondescript feeling.

However, Huo Qilong still felt good about himself.

At this moment, he seemed to have noticed Lin Fan standing at the side and said, “Oh, Sir, you’re here too.

“I can see that this beauty seems to like piano music very much. I suggest that you play more piano music for her when you have time. This way, she can always maintain a good mood.”

It had to be said that Huo Qilong was definitely not without brains.

On the contrary, he was very smart.

He did not goad Lin Fan into playing the piano like most people would.

Instead, he suggested that Lin Fan play the piano for his woman when he was free.

This way, his provocation was not abrupt.

At the same time, he thought that he made a mark on Chu Yunyue’s heart.
